layout_only_note: Step 3 'Kể qua tranh' of the One Story a Day mission has NO design mock. This contract checks layout facts only (no pixel comparison): order, texts, no overlap, no overflow, no horizontal scroll, reduced motion, contrast. Added after the R3 defect where the reader root had a fixed height and the result spilled under the help box and the credits.

built.driver: logged-in L1 child (R2L-SYNTHETIC-DESKTOP) with a completed mission, on the picture_retell stage before any attempt: board of 5 pictures + the record button. Stage is a VALUE in the real session view (see drivers/r2l-r3.mjs).

order_note: DOM order, not visual order: the help box (.lesson-support) is the FIRST child of the reader root in the DOM and is placed last by CSS, so it is checked by no_overlap and texts, not by order.
texts: Con nhìn 5 tranh theo thứ tự và kể cả câu chuyện bằng tiếng Anh. Bấm vào tranh để xem lớn hơn.
